answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. A inlet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ripple of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Reaching the spiral of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
